id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Ahoy, lad. Awake? It's morning, but it's dark as night. Enough to depress anyone.
"What, you don't know, lad? ...Take a look over there.
"They say that eerie darkness poured out of Heliodor Castle the day of the terrible explosion.
"Ever since, it's covered the sky, and we on this continent haven't seen the sun.
"...Phew. That was close. Those are monsters that came out of the castle with the darkness.
"Hmph. Hungry, and out here already. I can't hide here forever.
"I'd like to look after you, but I have to gather food at this hut. I can't leave.
"But you'd better go to the Last Bastion at once. It's safer.
"Our hope, the Hero, is there! He should protect you.
"Head west to reach Cobblestone Falls. The Last Bastion is just past it. Take care, lad. Until we meet again."
